rules.IDF: Security asks home postcode, then date of birth.
rules.IDW: The second wrong answer in total ends security.
rules.PC: Postcode is sent in capitals with one space before the last three characters.
rules.DOB: Date of birth is sent as DD/MM/YYYY.
rules.PENCE: create_promise takes pence as an integer; get_account gives pounds.
rules.FL: Floor: 15% of arrears rounded up to the whole pound, at least £30 (or the full arrears if below £30).
rules.CB: Callback today or next business day, after now, 08:30-20:00 Mon-Thu and 08:30-16:00 Fri, inclusive.
rules.CAL: Business days are Monday to Friday except the listed holidays.
rules.DL: Early: 9th business day after today. Late: the later of the 3rd business day after today and the last business day of the current month.
rules.ATT: Attempts after the opening ask: early 2, late 1.
rules.LAD: Early: full arrears on the 2nd business day, then floor on deadline. Late: floor on deadline.
rules.VUL: Vulnerability: transfer to arrears_support without asking, close TRANSFERRED/vulnerable.
rules.NOTE: add_note only for paid claims (CLAIMS_PAID) and disputes (DISPUTED).
